metadata.attribution: World Bank, ESMAP and PROBLUE; IMF World Seaborne Trade Monitoring System (Cerdeiro, Komaromi, Liu & Saeed, 2020).
metadata.method: Within each WGS84 1° cell, the percentage of original 0.005° cells with positive recorded AIS activity, using all original cell centres as the denominator, including land. This is spatial coverage over the entire six-year period. Cells with no recorded activity are omitted. No vessel count or transit frequency is inferred.

properties.title: All vessels · historical AIS coverage
properties.units: % of native cells with recorded AIS presence
